# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to macUSBoot.

macUSBoot is not a standalone product. It is a bootloader developed as part of
the macUSB workflow and is not intended for standalone installation. Its
functionality and purpose are defined by its released scope and the integration
requirements of macUSB.

For this reason, pull requests that introduce new functionality or expand
macUSBoot beyond the needs of the macUSB workflow may be declined.

Bug fixes and focused improvements are welcome.

Thank you for taking these project constraints into consideration.
